records.department: Department for Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Senior Citizens and Transgender Persons

eligibilityConditions.text: Person with the specific disability and age stated for the item, for example hearing aids at 51% disability and age 5-18, artificial limbs from age 6, wheelchairs from age 10.
Application through the OBMMS disabled welfare module.

unresolvedQuestions: The 2025-26 application window on OBMMS closed on 10-02-2026; whether a new window opened is not published.
Item availability depends on the annual annexure list, which is a spreadsheet rather than a scheme document.
records.notes: Added 2026-11-28. Item list and age/disability floors come from the official compilation; application through OBMMS.
records.benefitSummary: Free assistive aids: battery wheelchairs, retrofitted scooters, calipers, artificial limbs, crutches, hearing aids, daisy players, Braille books, smart phones, tablets, laptops and teaching material.

benefit.summary: Assistive device supplied free of cost

records.applicationNotes: OBMMS registration; requires a food security card number or MeeSeva income number.

records.name: PwD economic rehabilitation
records.officialName: Economic Rehabilitation Scheme for Persons with Disabilities
records.department: Department for Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Senior Citizens and Transgender Persons

eligibilityConditions.text: Person with disability setting up a petty trade or business unit.

unresolvedQuestions: The department page (unreachable from here) is reported to state 40% disability, age 21-55, income Rs 1.5 lakh rural / Rs 2 lakh urban and 100/80/70/60% slabs; the district page read here states only the subsidy pattern.
No state order for this scheme was located, so the age and income tests are unconfirmed.
records.notes: Added 2026-11-28. Only the district-published subsidy pattern is recorded; the eligibility test is an open question.
records.benefitSummary: Subsidy of 100% up to Rs 50,000 for non-bank-linked units; 80% subsidy on bank-linked units of Rs 1-3 lakh.

benefit.summary: Unit subsidy
benefit.amountNote: Rs 50,000 at 100% for non-bank-linked units; 80% subsidy for bank-linked units of Rs 1, 2 or 3 lakh.

records.name: PwD bus pass
records.officialName: Free and concessional bus passes for persons with disabilities
records.department: Department for Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Senior Citizens and Transgender Persons

eligibilityConditions.text: Visual impairment 100%, deaf and dumb 100%, locomotor disability 40%, intellectual disability with IQ below 69, or leprosy cured above 40%.

unresolvedQuestions: Whether the pass is issued for all TGSRTC services or city ordinary only is stated but not operational detail.
records.notes: Added 2026-11-28. Category-wise disability percentages are stated in the official compilation.

relationships.note: The general TGSRTC concession record covers other categories.

records.benefitSummary: Free travel in city ordinary buses and 50% concession on normal fares up to deluxe services.

benefit.summary: Free or concessional bus travel

records.applicationNotes: Apply at a TGSRTC bus pass counter with the disability certificate.
